outcome_review.expected: A reviewed generated receipt may extend one retained postdeployment prepublication attempt, preserving source, installed identity, original journal and all normal publication gates.
outcome_review.observed: The original generated-path refusal was reproduced. Frozen-tree derivation identifies the retained actual receipt. The added protocol validates exact source, canonical derived hashes, installed identity, remote baseline and public receipt before an evidence-preserving transition.
outcome_review.evidence: tests/test_receipt_continuation.py and docs/worktree-publication.md; source-bound fresh review and live completion are recorded by the invoking work owner.
outcome_review.limitations: The record binds artifacts and a review decision; hashes do not establish semantic benefit or authenticate an external reviewer. Broader interrupted-deployment cases remain refused.
